'''Steven Vallee''' (also published as '''Steve Vallee''') is a Star Wars CCG player. He finished 6th at [[February 2001 Meriden tournament]] on 10 February 2001, according to Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1715">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-meriden-ct-02-10-01d1715/ meriden-ct-02-10-01], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-meriden-ct-02-10-01d1715/ GitHub Pages].</ref> In January 2004 Joe Gualtieri wrote that Vallee ran Star Wars tournaments at Dragon's Lair in West Springfield, Massachusetts, usually on the first Saturday of the month.<ref name="pcf-2723-40044">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40044#40044 Eastern MA Players- New Place for Tournaments/ Judge Needed], Joe Gualtieri, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014342/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40044%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
